author: musho7-dev
subject: Add 4 funny vehicles: Turbo Cart, Couch Cruiser, Bath Racer, Ice Cream Van
body:
Code-drawn, shareable-clip vehicles with their own traits:
- Turbo Cart (900): shopping cart, wire basket, tiny wheels, big air
- Couch Cruiser (1600): purple sofa with cushions and a floor lamp, grippy
- Bath Racer (2200): bathtub with foam, faucet and rubber duck, bubble
  trail when accelerating, extra air control
- Ice Cream Van (2500): pink van with awning, sprinkles and a giant
  cone on the roof, bigger fuel tank
tools/car_gallery.gd renders vehicles side by side for quick checks.

(This commit also contains the data for 3 new maps, which come with
their drawing code in the next commit.)
